name: Cape Town
blurb: Cape Town remains one of the most discussed destinations in the country, with steady volume across the period and no unusual movement.

positive: Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
Good value compared with last year
negative: Prices noticeably up on last season
Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
